name: Quick-Witted's stab triggers Searing Quiver's Fire Arrows (#13043)
contract: Quick-Witted 704311 (Ranger, Brigand) fires its stab 704314 when you avoid an attack. #13043 reports that
the stab did not apply the quiver's effects. Searing Quiver 500103 tooltips that ranged abilities deal $s1%
(15%) additional direct Fire damage as Fire Arrows 681109, computed from the damage the hit actually dealt;
the stab is DmgClass 3 (ranged) but triggered, which the Ranger quiver hit handler skipped. Expected: the
first stab is followed by exactly one Fire Arrows worth 15% of the stab's dealt damage, or 30% on a critical
Fire Arrows (no talents raise either), so the pair must land between 5% and 30%; partial Fire resists lower
it (a first run measured 10.8%), and before the fix no Fire Arrows followed the stab at all. A second Fire
Arrows for the same stab fails the count. A doubled percentage that is also partially resisted can overlap a
critical one, so the bound catches it only when the doubled hit lands unresisted or crits. The mob has
1,000,000 health so overkill never trims the stab, Evasion (5277, +50% dodge) makes avoided attacks
frequent, and the ranger never attacks, so the Fire Arrows can only come from the stab. Hit rating fixtures
keep the Fire Arrows from missing.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Keep the ranger alive while the mob swings
SETUP: Searing Quiver is the active quiver
SETUP: Evasion makes avoided attacks frequent
SETUP: the mob is attacking the ranger
SETUP: an avoided attack fires the first Quick-Witted stab
SETUP: the check sees exactly one stab
#13043: the stab is followed by exactly one Fire Arrows
#13043: that Fire Arrows deals at most 15% of the stab (30% if it crits)
